why: Every credential shape a route can be reached with. The five kinds the API accepts, the refusals in between, and the one it cannot check. A route gates on who the caller is before it gates on anything else, so this matrix is run against all of them.

variants.label: a bearer token that is not a token
a bearer scheme with nothing after it
a scheme that is not bearer
a session token signed with another secret
a session token that has expired
a session token minted for another audience
a session token for an account that is switched off
an agent token from a provider this deployment cannot read
an API key, which only an api_access workspace accepts
an API key nothing was issued for
the session cookie the web app sends
a member whose role may write but not delete
a member whose membership has no role
a member of no workspace the route is about
